name: Portrait Photography
intro:
My portrait photography is all about authenticity. Whether you need professional headshots, creative editorial portraits or personal images for a special moment, I create a relaxed environment where your personality can shine through. Each session is tailored to your style, from bold and creative to soft and natural.

These packages are for shoots on location. For studio shoots, see Studio Portrait Photography below.

I document them with discretion, creativity and care, so you can stay present while I preserve the memories. name: Social Media Video Editing
intro:
Video editing is available by special request only, so get in touch with your project and I’ll let you know if I can take it on.

Short-form content takes time, not just to edit but to get right. Pacing, captions, sound and transitions all shape how your video performs. I tailor every edit to your style, so it holds attention and is ready to post on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.

packages.name: Essential Edit
packages.details:
60–90 seconds
Clean cuts and pacing
Basic transitions
Light colour correction
Clean static captions

packages.name: Content Edit
packages.details:
Up to 2 minutes
Mixed transitions (zooms, speed ramps)
Styled captions with highlighted keywords
Light sound effects and refined colour grading
B-roll overlays

packages.name: Creator Edit
packages.details:
2–3 minutes
Advanced pacing and sequencing
Match cuts and seamless transitions
Dynamic captions
Music and sound effect layering, colour grading*

packages.name: Premium Edit
packages.details:
2–3 minutes+
Masking and morphing transitions
Animated captions and motion graphics
Full sound design, cinematic colour grading*
Cover design

included:
A short brief so I understand how you want your content to feel
Revisions: one round for Essential and Content edits, two for Creator and Premium
Final videos exported for your chosen platforms
notes:
*Colour grading on these packages needs footage recorded in Log format.
You supply all footage, audio and assets. Filming isn’t included unless agreed separately.
You’re responsible for having the rights to any music you provide. Any music I source is royalty-free or licensed.
Project files aren’t included unless requested, and may incur an extra fee.
